plugins.name: bakjob-surdeg
plugins.description: Sourdough starter for new projects: bootstrap interviews you about stack, languages, version control, issue tracking, testing and workflow, then writes CLAUDE.md, a vault and .claude/settings.json and enables the right bakjob plugins (or copies their skills and agents into the project). feed changes part of the setup later; doctor checks it.

plugins.name: bakjob-core
plugins.description: Everyday workflow for a bootstrapped project: git checkpoints, vault upkeep and decision records, smoke tests, a test runner, an architect for hard plans, a config-value auditor and the question desk artifact.

plugins.name: bakjob-github
plugins.description: GitHub Issues workflow with real gh commands: create and claim issues, in progress / in review labels, close only when verified.

plugins.name: bakjob-linear
plugins.description: Linear workflow with real Linear MCP calls: pull issue context, claim, move through In Progress / In Review / Done.

plugins.name: bakjob-web
plugins.description: Web project tools: SEO, accessibility and performance audits, before/after screenshots of UI changes, anti-slop frontend design, redesign audits, families of similar content pages, and deploys to Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages, containers or FTP hosting.

plugins.name: bakjob-game
plugins.description: Game project tools: engine conventions for Godot, Unity, Phaser and Bevy, a performance auditor against your frame budget, playtests that split provable checks from feel, an accessibility checklist, and releases to itch.io and Steam.
